details:
The runC tool is a lightweight, portable implementation of the Open Container Format (OCF) that provides container runtime.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * net/url: golang: golang net/url: Denial of Service from quadratic complexity in path resolution (CVE-2026-56860)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
